script:
Wang Guoqing
Wang Guoqing is Wang Writer's only son. Two years ago, Wang Guoqing's mother died mysteriously. His father Wang Writer, as a mystery novelist, conducted extensive reasoning about the entire incident from many aspects, but every clue led to a dead end. His father told Wang Guoqing that there was no detective in the world more professional than himself - if even he couldn't investigate it, reporting to police would be useless. Wang Guoqing also deeply understood his father's abilities, so he didn't insist that his father report to police. But his father showed no emotion about his mother's death, investigating like a detached detective, which greatly disappointed Wang Guoqing. Afterward, his father even published a novel "Dark and Windy Night," where the death method of the woman killed by her husband was almost identical to Wang Guoqing's mother's death, which made Wang Guoqing even more chilled and heartbroken.
After a year, Wang Guoqing moved with his father to live in Zhen Youcai's castle. Zhen Youcai was his father's good friend, and the two often exchanged reasoning experiences together. Soon after coming to Zhen Youcai's home, his father's assistant Ding Assistant also moved over. Wang Guoqing discovered that besides Zhen Youcai, the castle residents included Zhen Youcai's son Zhen Gongzi, castle butler Li Butler and his daughter Zhang Xiaomei.
Zhang Xiaomei was about the same age as Wang Guoqing and was a very beautiful girl. Her mysterious and melancholy temperament particularly attracted Wang Guoqing. Wang Guoqing began gradually approaching Zhang Xiaomei and discovered that she wasn't a cold person - rather, she carried too much burden. Zhang Xiaomei told him she grew up in the castle, and because Zhen Gongzi was an arrogant person who looked down on this butler's daughter, she had never had friends. Being at the age of youth, the two quickly sparked love.
Wang Guoqing always wanted to ask his father about "Dark and Windy Night," but his father always avoided the topic by claiming to be busy with work. Wang Guoqing had to try approaching Ding Assistant instead. Ding Assistant was someone Wang Guoqing got along well with - both worshipped and were awed by Wang Writer's abilities. When they chatted, Wang Guoqing told him about himself and Zhang Xiaomei, and learned from Ding Assistant that his father had always reasoned these novel plots himself. Ding Assistant couldn't help much, but his father often got inspiration from Zhen Youcai, and sometimes Zhen Youcai would give him strange and peculiar items. Wang Guoqing was shocked to discover that some of these so-called strange and peculiar items had actually appeared at the crime scene back then. He realized with a chill that his mother's death was truly related to his father, and very likely his father had done it himself.
With an extremely complex heart, although Wang Guoqing hated why his father was so terrifying, he couldn't really use killing his father as a method to avenge his mother. He could only confide in Zhang Xiaomei, but didn't mention his father's matter - only told her that Zhen Youcai wasn't a good person and had corrupted his father. But this statement unexpectedly resonated with Zhang Xiaomei, who told him a secret she had always hidden.
It turned out Zhang Xiaomei was Zhen Youcai's illegitimate daughter. After her mother became pregnant, Zhen Youcai abandoned her mother, but her mother kept missing Zhen Youcai, becoming melancholy and finally dying when Zhang Xiaomei was five years old. The homeless Zhang Xiaomei was adopted by Li Butler, but when she first saw Zhen Youcai, she immediately recognized him as the heartless man in the photograph her mother held daily. Zhang Xiaomei hated his disappearance without goodbye, hated that he made her mother die early. She wanted Zhen Youcai to pay with his life for her mother.
Having a common enemy made Wang Guoqing trust Zhang Xiaomei even more. On November 25th, they agreed to kill Zhen Youcai together on December 5th, avenging their respective mothers. What Zhang Xiaomei didn't know was that this day was exactly the anniversary of Wang Guoqing's mother's death.
[December 5th Evening]
Around 10:20 PM, Wang Guoqing and Zhang Xiaomei came to Zhen Youcai's room as agreed. The room was very dark. Wang Guoqing told Zhang Xiaomei to keep watch at the door and went in himself. Because Zhen Youcai had been chronically ill, he rarely got out of bed and was very weak. Wang Guoqing quietly approached Zhen Youcai, but Zhen Youcai suddenly started speaking: "Don't come closer, don't come closer..." Wang Guoqing realized he had been discovered and pounced on Zhen Youcai, wrestling with him. Zhen Youcai seemed to have a final burst of energy and was quite strong. Finally, Wang Guoqing had to grab a hard object nearby in the darkness and strike Zhen Youcai's back of the head. Seeing that Zhen Youcai wasn't moving, he carefully wiped the blood from the hard object with his clothes and placed it back where it belonged from memory, then restored Zhen Youcai's sleeping position. After handling everything, he came out and pulled Zhang Xiaomei to leave quickly. But after not walking far, they suddenly heard footsteps behind them. Just as Wang Guoqing was about to go back and check, Zhang Xiaomei held him back, saying she was more familiar with the castle layout and should go look instead. Seeing it wasn't time to be polite, Wang Guoqing told her to be careful and then quickly left.
acts_goal: Secret not to reveal proactively: Father very likely designed a killing scheme to murder his own mother.
